description.value:
♍ Virgo rises Exalted today. This is the one day in two hundred and sixty. For the whole day your Techniques heighten as though you were 8 levels higher, and you have your Zenith Boon.

As the Ascendant Boon, plus once per minute ◆◆◆, 60-foot emanation, Will save against your Cosmo DC or lose all five senses for 1 minute; a critical failure lasts until restoration. Incapacitation.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. A Zenith is scheduled by the GM, never rolled.

rules.text: On a hit, the target must attempt a Will save against your Cosmo DC or lose a sense.
rules.title: Six Paths of Transmigration
